items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: And Poiré Nolan, Little Willie, Little Dookie, Little Sammy.

ctx.x: And Poiré Nolan, Little Willie, Little Dookie, Little Sammy.
Little Sammy. Were some of those fellows mostly blues players, or did they play ragtime? Well, they played ragtime. Jazz, jazz piano.
